headline: Gold prices drop by Rs3,500 per tola in Pakistan
summary: Gold prices in Pakistan fell by Rs3,500 per tola to Rs376,336 following a decline in international bullion markets.
why: The All-Pakistan Gems and Jewellers Sarafa Association sets daily benchmark precious metals prices across Pakistan.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Domestic gold prices tracked lower international spot metal market rates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Declines in international spot gold prices pulled down local jewelry market rates.
